props.name: providers
props.description: Which providers to offer, in order.

props.name: layout
props.description: stack is full-width labelled buttons; row is a line of square marks that keep their names for assistive tech.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Start sign-in. Return a promise to show that provider as pending until it settles.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the reason when `onSelect` rejects.

props.name: loadingProvider
props.description: Controlled pending provider — for redirects that never resolve a promise.

props.name: lastUsed
props.description: The provider this browser used last time. It gets a quiet hint.

props.name: verb
props.description: The words before the provider name.
